WITH earliest_primary AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        payer_class,
        submission_date AS first_submission_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key
        ORDER BY submission_date ASC NULLS LAST, source_file_id ASC NULLS LAST, claim_id ASC
    ) = 1
),
paid_claims AS (
    SELECT
        ep.payer_class,
        (r.payment_date - ep.first_submission_date) AS days_to_pay
    FROM earliest_primary AS ep
    JOIN sem.remit_claims AS r
        ON r.claim_key = ep.claim_key
       AND r.payer_key = ep.payer_key
    WHERE r.is_current_adjudication
      AND r.paid_amount > 0
      AND r.payment_date IS NOT NULL
      AND ep.first_submission_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    payer_class,
    COUNT(*) AS paid_claim_count,
    ROUND(quantile_cont(days_to_pay, 0.5), 1) AS median_days_to_pay,
    ROUND(quantile_cont(days_to_pay, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days_to_pay
FROM paid_claims
GROUP BY payer_class
ORDER BY payer_class ASC NULLS LAST

WITH denied_carc_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        rc.claim_key,
        rc.payer_key,
        a.carc_code
    FROM sem.remit_claims AS rc
    JOIN sem.adjustments AS a
        ON a.remit_claim_id = rc.remit_claim_id
    WHERE rc.is_current_adjudication
      AND rc.is_denied
      AND a.group_code = 'CO'
      AND a.is_denial_carc
)
SELECT
    carc_code,
    COUNT(*) AS denied_claim_payer_count
FROM denied_carc_pairs
GROUP BY carc_code
ORDER BY denied_claim_payer_count DESC, carc_code ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH claim_payer_pair AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) AS current_event_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied_event_count
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        payer_class,
        (event_count = 1 AND current_event_count = 1 AND denied_event_count = 0) AS is_first_pass
    FROM claim_payer_pair
),
by_class AS (
    SELECT
        payer_class,
        COUNT(*) AS remitted_pair_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_first_pass) AS first_pass_resolved_count
    FROM classified
    GROUP BY payer_class
)
SELECT
    payer_class,
    remitted_pair_count,
    first_pass_resolved_count,
    ROUND(CAST(first_pass_resolved_count AS DOUBLE) / remitted_pair_count * 100, 2) AS first_pass_resolution_rate_percent
FROM by_class
ORDER BY 1

WITH pair_trace AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class,
        COUNT(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) FILTER (
            WHERE check_or_eft_number IS NOT NULL
              AND check_or_eft_number <> ''
        ) AS distinct_trace_count,
        BOOL_OR(is_reversal) AS includes_reversal,
        BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current_adjudication,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_current_adjudication THEN paid_amount END), 0) AS current_paid
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
)
SELECT
    payer_class,
    COUNT(*) AS multi_trace_pairs,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE includes_reversal) AS pairs_with_reversal,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current_adjudication) AS pairs_without_current,
    ROUND(SUM(current_paid), 2) AS current_paid_total
FROM pair_trace
WHERE distinct_trace_count >= 2
GROUP BY payer_class
ORDER BY 1

WHERE a.group_code = 'PR'

WITH latest_claim AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        referring_npi,
        service_month
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE is_latest_submission
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key
        ORDER BY submission_date DESC NULLS LAST, claim_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
in_window AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        referring_npi,
        service_month
    FROM latest_claim
    WHERE service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01'
),
month_total AS (
    SELECT
        service_month,
        COUNT(*) AS total_claims
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY service_month
),
npi_count AS (
    SELECT
        service_month,
        referring_npi,
        COUNT(*) AS npi_claims
    FROM in_window
    WHERE referring_npi IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY service_month, referring_npi
),
ranked_npi AS (
    SELECT
        service_month,
        npi_claims,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY service_month
            ORDER BY npi_claims DESC, referring_npi ASC
        ) AS npi_rank
    FROM npi_count
),
top_five AS (
    SELECT
        service_month,
        SUM(npi_claims) AS top5_claims
    FROM ranked_npi
    WHERE npi_rank <= 5
    GROUP BY service_month
)
SELECT
    strftime(month_total.service_month, '%Y-%m') AS service_month,
    month_total.total_claims,
    COALESCE(top_five.top5_claims, 0) AS top5_claims,
    ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(top_five.top5_claims, 0) AS DOUBLE) / month_total.total_claims * 100, 1) AS top5_share_percent
FROM month_total
LEFT JOIN top_five
  ON top_five.service_month = month_total.service_month
ORDER BY month_total.service_month
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '87798')::DOUBLE / SUM(line_paid_amount)::DOUBLE, 4) AS cpt_share_of_line_payments FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH current_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        is_denied
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
),
latest_nonvoid_bill AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        claim_id
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE COALESCE(TRY_CAST(frequency_code AS INTEGER), -1) <> 8
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key, payer_key
        ORDER BY submission_date DESC NULLS LAST, source_file_id DESC NULLS LAST, claim_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
pair_procedure AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cp.claim_key,
        cp.payer_key,
        cp.is_denied,
        cl.procedure_code
    FROM current_pairs AS cp
    JOIN latest_nonvoid_bill AS bill
        ON bill.claim_key = cp.claim_key
       AND bill.payer_key = cp.payer_key
    JOIN sem.claim_lines AS cl
        ON cl.claim_id = bill.claim_id
)
SELECT
    procedure_code,
    COUNT(*) AS current_adjudication_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS denial_rate
FROM pair_procedure
GROUP BY procedure_code
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY procedure_code ASC NULLS LAST

WITH primary_current AS (
    SELECT
        claims.line_count,
        claims.charge_amount,
        remit_claims.is_denied
    FROM sem.claims AS claims
    JOIN sem.remit_claims AS remit_claims
      ON remit_claims.claim_key = claims.claim_key
     AND remit_claims.payer_key = claims.payer_key
     AND remit_claims.is_current_adjudication
    WHERE claims.is_latest_submission
      AND claims.payer_responsibility = 'P'
      AND claims.line_count >= 1
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN line_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN line_count = 2 THEN '2'
            ELSE '3+'
        END AS line_count_bucket,
        charge_amount,
        is_denied
    FROM primary_current
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        line_count_bucket,
        COUNT(*) AS claim_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied_claim_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_denied), 0) AS denied_billed_charge
    FROM bucketed
    GROUP BY line_count_bucket
)
SELECT
    line_count_bucket,
    claim_count,
    denied_claim_count,
    ROUND(CAST(denied_claim_count AS DOUBLE) / claim_count * 100, 2) AS denial_rate_percent,
    denied_billed_charge
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY CASE line_count_bucket WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

WITH carry_forward AS (
    SELECT
        provider_adjustment_id,
        payer_key,
        reference_id,
        payment_date,
        provider_adjustment_amount
    FROM sem.provider_adjustments
    WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB'
      AND provider_adjustment_amount < 0
),
fb_row AS (
    SELECT
        payer_key,
        reference_id,
        payment_date,
        provider_adjustment_amount
    FROM sem.provider_adjustments
    WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB'
)
SELECT
    carry_forward.reference_id,
    carry_forward.payment_date AS carry_forward_payment_date,
    ROUND(-carry_forward.provider_adjustment_amount, 2) AS amount_carried,
    MIN(fb_row.payment_date) AS offset_payment_date,
    MIN(fb_row.payment_date) - carry_forward.payment_date AS days_to_offset
FROM carry_forward
LEFT JOIN fb_row
  ON fb_row.payer_key = carry_forward.payer_key
 AND fb_row.reference_id = carry_forward.reference_id
 AND fb_row.provider_adjustment_amount = -carry_forward.provider_adjustment_amount
 AND fb_row.payment_date > carry_forward.payment_date
GROUP BY
    carry_forward.provider_adjustment_id,
    carry_forward.reference_id,
    carry_forward.payment_date,
    carry_forward.provider_adjustment_amount
ORDER BY 2, 1

WITH class_month AS (
    SELECT
        payer_class,
        payment_month,
        SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
      AND payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01')
    GROUP BY payer_class, payment_month
),
month_total AS (
    SELECT
        payment_month,
        SUM(paid_amount) AS total_paid
    FROM class_month
    GROUP BY payment_month
),
wide AS (
    SELECT
        class_month.payer_class,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN class_month.payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN class_month.paid_amount END), 0) AS july_paid,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN class_month.payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01' THEN class_month.paid_amount END), 0) AS august_paid,
        (SELECT total_paid FROM month_total WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01') AS july_total,
        (SELECT total_paid FROM month_total WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01') AS august_total
    FROM class_month
    GROUP BY class_month.payer_class
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        payer_class,
        CASE
            WHEN july_total IS NULL OR july_total = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE july_paid * 100 / july_total
        END AS july_share,
        CASE
            WHEN august_total IS NULL OR august_total = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE august_paid * 100 / august_total
        END AS august_share
    FROM wide
)
SELECT
    payer_class,
    ROUND(july_share, 1) AS july_share_percent,
    ROUND(august_share, 1) AS august_share_percent,
    ROUND(august_share - july_share, 1) AS share_change_pp
FROM shares
ORDER BY 1

WITH pair_dates AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        MIN(submission_date) FILTER (
            WHERE COALESCE(TRY_CAST(frequency_code AS INTEGER), -1) = 1
        ) AS original_date,
        MIN(submission_date) FILTER (
            WHERE COALESCE(TRY_CAST(frequency_code AS INTEGER), -1) = 7
        ) AS first_replacement_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
corrected AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        original_date,
        first_replacement_date
    FROM pair_dates
    WHERE original_date IS NOT NULL
      AND first_replacement_date IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key
        ORDER BY first_replacement_date ASC, payer_key ASC
    ) = 1
),
measured AS (
    SELECT
        c.claim_key,
        c.first_replacement_date - c.original_date AS days_original_to_replacement,
        CASE
            WHEN r.payment_date >= c.first_replacement_date
            THEN r.payment_date - c.original_date
        END AS days_original_to_payment,
        CASE
            WHEN r.payment_date >= c.first_replacement_date
            THEN r.paid_amount
        END AS qualified_paid_amount
    FROM corrected AS c
    LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims AS r
        ON r.claim_key = c.claim_key
       AND r.payer_key = c.payer_key
       AND r.is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS corrected_claim_count,
    ROUND(AVG(days_original_to_replacement), 2) AS avg_days_original_to_first_replacement,
    COUNT(days_original_to_payment) AS current_adjudication_on_or_after_replacement_count,
    ROUND(AVG(days_original_to_payment), 2) AS avg_days_original_to_payment,
    COALESCE(SUM(qualified_paid_amount), 0) AS total_paid_amount
FROM measured

WITH voided_pair AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        MAX(submission_date) AS void_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE frequency_code = '8'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
pair_flag AS (
    SELECT
        voided_pair.claim_key,
        voided_pair.payer_key,
        COALESCE(BOOL_OR(
            remit.paid_amount > 0
            AND remit.payment_date < voided_pair.void_date
        ), FALSE) AS had_positive_payment_before,
        COALESCE(BOOL_OR(
            remit.is_reversal
            AND remit.payment_date >= voided_pair.void_date
        ), FALSE) AS had_reversal_on_or_after,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN remit.is_current_adjudication THEN remit.paid_amount END), 0) AS current_paid
    FROM voided_pair
    LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims AS remit
      ON remit.claim_key = voided_pair.claim_key
     AND remit.payer_key = voided_pair.payer_key
    GROUP BY voided_pair.claim_key, voided_pair.payer_key
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS voided_pair_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE had_positive_payment_before) AS paid_before_void_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE had_reversal_on_or_after) AS reversal_on_or_after_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(current_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid_total
FROM pair_flag

SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_paid_not_denied_count
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication
  AND paid_amount = 0
  AND NOT is_denied

WITH latest_correction AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        payer_class,
        submission_date AS replacement_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE frequency_code = '7'
      AND submission_date IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key, payer_key
        ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
first_response AS (
    SELECT
        latest_correction.payer_class,
        latest_correction.claim_key,
        latest_correction.payer_key,
        MIN(remit.payment_date) - latest_correction.replacement_date AS days_to_first_response
    FROM latest_correction
    JOIN sem.remit_claims AS remit
      ON remit.claim_key = latest_correction.claim_key
     AND remit.payer_key = latest_correction.payer_key
     AND remit.payment_date >= latest_correction.replacement_date
    GROUP BY
        latest_correction.payer_class,
        latest_correction.claim_key,
        latest_correction.payer_key,
        latest_correction.replacement_date
)
SELECT
    payer_class,
    COUNT(*) AS responded_pair_count,
    ROUND(AVG(days_to_first_response), 1) AS average_days,
    MIN(days_to_first_response) AS minimum_days,
    MAX(days_to_first_response) AS maximum_days
FROM first_response
GROUP BY payer_class
ORDER BY 1

WITH earliest_primary AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        payer_class,
        submission_date AS first_submission_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key
        ORDER BY submission_date ASC NULLS LAST, source_file_id ASC NULLS LAST, claim_id ASC
    ) = 1
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT
        ep.payer_class,
        ep.first_submission_date,
        (
            SELECT MIN(r.payment_date)
            FROM sem.remit_claims AS r
            WHERE r.claim_key = ep.claim_key
              AND r.payer_key = ep.payer_key
        ) AS first_payment_date
    FROM earliest_primary AS ep
    WHERE ep.first_submission_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'
),
by_class AS (
    SELECT
        payer_class,
        COUNT(*) AS cohort_claim_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE first_payment_date IS NOT NULL
              AND (first_payment_date - first_submission_date) <= 14
        ) AS remitted_within_14_count
    FROM cohort
    GROUP BY payer_class
)
SELECT
    payer_class,
    cohort_claim_count,
    remitted_within_14_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * remitted_within_14_count / cohort_claim_count, 1) AS within_14_pct
FROM by_class
ORDER BY payer_class ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0482')::DOUBLE / SUM(line_paid_amount)::DOUBLE, 4) AS cpt_share_of_line_payments FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH frequency_seven AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        MAX(submission_date) AS correction_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE frequency_code = '7'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
qualified_pair AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        frequency_seven.claim_key,
        frequency_seven.payer_key,
        frequency_seven.correction_date
    FROM frequency_seven
    JOIN sem.remit_claims AS prior_denial
      ON prior_denial.claim_key = frequency_seven.claim_key
     AND prior_denial.payer_key = frequency_seven.payer_key
     AND prior_denial.claim_status_code = '4'
     AND prior_denial.is_reversal = FALSE
     AND prior_denial.payment_date < frequency_seven.correction_date
),
pair_outcome AS (
    SELECT
        qualified_pair.claim_key,
        qualified_pair.payer_key,
        COALESCE(BOOL_OR(remit.payment_date >= qualified_pair.correction_date), FALSE) AS has_later_remit,
        COALESCE(BOOL_OR(remit.is_current_adjudication), FALSE) AS has_current,
        COALESCE(BOOL_OR(remit.is_current_adjudication AND remit.is_denied), FALSE) AS current_denied,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN remit.is_current_adjudication THEN remit.paid_amount END), 0) AS current_paid
    FROM qualified_pair
    LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims AS remit
      ON remit.claim_key = qualified_pair.claim_key
     AND remit.payer_key = qualified_pair.payer_key
    GROUP BY qualified_pair.claim_key, qualified_pair.payer_key
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT has_later_remit THEN 'no remit since correction'
        WHEN has_current AND NOT current_denied THEN 'overturned'
        ELSE 'denied again'
    END AS outcome,
    COUNT(*) AS pair_count,
    ROUND(SUM(current_paid), 2) AS current_paid_total
FROM pair_outcome
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS overturned_claim_payer_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(rc.paid_amount), 0) AS total_current_paid_amount
FROM sem.remit_claims AS rc
WHERE rc.is_current_adjudication
  AND NOT rc.is_denied
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sem.remit_claims AS earlier
      WHERE earlier.claim_key = rc.claim_key
        AND earlier.payer_key = rc.payer_key
        AND earlier.remit_claim_id <> rc.remit_claim_id
        AND NOT earlier.is_current_adjudication
        AND NOT earlier.is_reversal
        AND earlier.is_denied
        AND NOT earlier.is_duplicate_claim_denial
  )

WITH nonvoid_latest AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        charge_amount
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE is_latest_submission
      AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(frequency_code AS INTEGER), -1) <> 8
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key
        ORDER BY submission_date DESC NULLS LAST, source_file_id DESC NULLS LAST, claim_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
first_primary AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        MIN(submission_date) AS first_submission_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    GROUP BY claim_key
),
open_claims AS (
    SELECT
        nv.claim_key,
        nv.charge_amount,
        DATE '2026-08-14' - fp.first_submission_date AS age_days
    FROM nonvoid_latest AS nv
    JOIN first_primary AS fp
        ON fp.claim_key = nv.claim_key
    WHERE fp.first_submission_date IS NOT NULL
      AND fp.first_submission_date <= DATE '2026-08-14'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM sem.claims AS c
          JOIN sem.remit_claims AS r
              ON r.claim_key = c.claim_key
             AND r.payer_key = c.payer_key
             AND r.is_current_adjudication
          WHERE c.claim_key = nv.claim_key
            AND c.payer_responsibility = 'P'
      )
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN age_days BETWEEN 0 AND 14 THEN '0-14'
            WHEN age_days BETWEEN 15 AND 29 THEN '15-29'
            WHEN age_days >= 30 THEN '30+'
        END AS age_bucket,
        claim_key,
        charge_amount
    FROM open_claims
    WHERE age_days >= 0
)
SELECT
    buckets.age_bucket,
    COUNT(bucketed.claim_key) AS claim_count,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(bucketed.claim_key) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(bucketed.charge_amount)
    END AS total_billed_charge
FROM (
    SELECT '0-14' AS age_bucket, 1 AS bucket_order
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '15-29', 2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '30+', 3
) AS buckets
LEFT JOIN bucketed
    ON bucketed.age_bucket = buckets.age_bucket
GROUP BY buckets.age_bucket, buckets.bucket_order
ORDER BY buckets.bucket_order

WITH qualifying_line AS (
    SELECT
        payer_name,
        procedure_code,
        line_allowed_amount
    FROM sem.remit_lines
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
      AND NOT line_is_denied
      AND units_paid = 1
      AND line_allowed_amount > 0
),
allowed_frequency AS (
    SELECT
        payer_name,
        procedure_code,
        line_allowed_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS line_frequency
    FROM qualifying_line
    GROUP BY payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount
),
typical_allowed AS (
    SELECT
        payer_name,
        procedure_code,
        line_allowed_amount AS typical_allowed_amount
    FROM allowed_frequency
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY payer_name, procedure_code
        ORDER BY line_frequency DESC, line_allowed_amount DESC
    ) = 1
),
line_gap AS (
    SELECT
        qualifying_line.payer_name,
        qualifying_line.line_allowed_amount < typical_allowed.typical_allowed_amount AS is_underpaid,
        typical_allowed.typical_allowed_amount - qualifying_line.line_allowed_amount AS gap_amount
    FROM qualifying_line
    JOIN typical_allowed
      ON typical_allowed.payer_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM qualifying_line.payer_name
     AND typical_allowed.procedure_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM qualifying_line.procedure_code
)
SELECT
    payer_name,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_underpaid) AS underpaid_line_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gap_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_underpaid), 0), 2) AS shortfall
FROM line_gap
GROUP BY payer_name
ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1 ASC
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0480')::DOUBLE / SUM(line_paid_amount)::DOUBLE, 4) AS cpt_share_of_line_payments FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH month_counts AS (
    SELECT
        payer_class,
        payment_month,
        COUNT(*) AS current_adjudication_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied_count
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
    GROUP BY payer_class, payment_month
),
month_rates AS (
    SELECT
        payer_class,
        payment_month,
        current_adjudication_count,
        denied_count,
        CAST(denied_count AS DOUBLE) / current_adjudication_count AS denial_ratio
    FROM month_counts
)
SELECT
    payer_class,
    strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS payment_month_label,
    current_adjudication_count,
    denied_count,
    ROUND(denial_ratio * 100, 2) AS denial_rate_percent,
    ROUND(
        (
            denial_ratio - LAG(denial_ratio) OVER (
                PARTITION BY payer_class
                ORDER BY payment_month
            )
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS month_over_month_change_pp
FROM month_rates
ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '81479')::DOUBLE / SUM(line_paid_amount)::DOUBLE, 4) AS cpt_share_of_line_payments FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH latest_primary AS (
    SELECT
        claim_key,
        payer_key,
        referring_npi
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key
        ORDER BY submission_date DESC NULLS LAST, source_file_id DESC NULLS LAST, claim_id DESC
    ) = 1
)
SELECT
    lp.referring_npi,
    COUNT(*) AS adjudicated_claim_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.is_denied) AS denied_claim_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.is_denied) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS denial_rate
FROM latest_primary AS lp
JOIN sem.remit_claims AS r
    ON r.claim_key = lp.claim_key
   AND r.payer_key = lp.payer_key
   AND r.is_current_adjudication
WHERE lp.referring_npi IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY lp.referring_npi
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15
ORDER BY denial_rate DESC, lp.referring_npi ASC
LIMIT 5
